How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Delhi is 11th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month, plus HRA at 27%.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: You need a 1st class Graduate or Post-graduate degree in ECE/EE/E&T with GATE qualification or relevant experience in full-wave electromagnetic simulators.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you send your complete application with all required documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. Can the NET/GATE requirement be relaxed?
faq.answer: Yes, the NET/GATE requirement can be relaxed for graduates from CFTIs with a CGPA of 8.000 or above.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section provided in this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Junior Research Fellow position is contractual.
